description: Check this mailbox for new mail now, instead of at its next regular check (about every 60 seconds). Also retries an SMTP/IMAP mailbox whose login the mail server refused: we try its saved logins first, and answer 409 if the server still refuses the IMAP login, or 429 with the time to wait while we hold back sign-ins to that server (for example, after it refused too many from your workspace this hour). When the SMTP and IMAP logins both work, we clear the login failure so sending and warmup can resume, as after update_mailbox_credentials. Other holds and your own pause stay in place. When the server still refuses only the SMTP login, we start reading the mailbox again and answer 409 because sending stays off until SMTP works too. A send-only mailbox receives nothing here and answers 409.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: resync_mailbox
title: Check a mailbox now
